datasets.name: Olist Brazilian E-Commerce
datasets.citation: Olist (2018). Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist. Kaggle, https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/olistbr/brazilian-ecommerce
datasets.role: small-seller behaviour: orders per seller, repeat buying, delivery delays, reviews

datasets.name: UCI Online Retail II
datasets.citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D
datasets.role: validation corpus for order-sheet intake and order metrics; not a benchmark for small sellers

datasets.name: UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention
datasets.domain: website sessions of an online shop
datasets.licence: not stated in UCI's metadata: confirm on the UCI page; cited, not redistributed
datasets.citation: Sakar, C. and Kastro, Y. (2018). Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5F88Q
datasets.role: conversion and new-vs-returning visitors; checks that intent signals outweigh light interest

datasets.name: UCI Bank Marketing
datasets.domain: bank phone campaigns (contact history and outcome)
datasets.licence: see UCI page; cited, not redistributed
datasets.role: learned challenger and sanity check for the lead score: contact history (bought before, recency)
datasets.result: trained logistic regression on 4 contact-history inputs (see the lead model card)

datasets.name: F1 race calendar (Jolpica-F1)
datasets.licence: open API, no key; factual schedule
datasets.role: market context for the Box Box case study: race weekends are demand windows

datasets.name: Wikipedia page views: Formula One
datasets.role: evidence that race weekends raise interest, so timing advice can cite a number

not_used: Instagram insights tutorial CSV (no stated licence); M5 (Kaggle competition terms, non-commercial); Kaggle/Maven datasets that fit other business types
